routes.reason: Cursor-paginated Insights discovery listing, called both with status=discovered and unfiltered for link reconciliation. No committed cassette: Insights rejects service-account credentials, and the WS3 recorder mints from a PMAK in a gitignored .env, so this route cannot be captured by the existing local recording path.

Creates the catalog collection for a discovered service. Mutating and non-idempotent at the wire level (guarded in-process by mutateOnceThenReconcile), so it is proven live rather than replayed until WS5 models the reconcile state machine.
Associates a service with its originating git repository. Requires a real workspace/environment/service triple that only exists after live discovery, so there is no committed cassette.

Page-numbered provider-service listing used to resolve the canonical Insights service id. The akita surface returns 401 'Postman User not found' for service-account identities, so it needs a human-user session token that cannot be minted in CI or by the WS3 recorder.
Acknowledges provider-service onboarding. Same human-user-session requirement as the akita listing route, and mutating, so it is not replayed offline.
Reads workspace onboarding acknowledgment state to decide whether the write is needed. Human-user session token required; no committed cassette.
Writes the workspace onboarding acknowledgment. Human-user session token required; mutating, so it is proven live.

Fetches the workspace team-verification token surfaced to the operator for agent install. Human-user session token required; the response is credential material, which is a further reason not to hold it in a committed fixture.

Mints a real Postman API key through the Bifrost identity service. Deliberately never simulated: a cassette of this route would either carry live key material or teach the suite to assert against a fabricated credential shape. The call site is covered by unit tests with an injected fetch double instead.
Lists application bindings to reconcile before creating one. Direct call to the observability host (not the Bifrost proxy) and PMAK-authenticated; no committed cassette.

Creates the application binding. A live probe showed this route rejects both x-access-token and x-api-key for service-account identities with 401 'Postman User not found', so it stays PMAK-primary and is proven only against a human-user credential.
Resolves the access-token session identity that gates org mode and the consumerType=user requirement. Response is session identity material; no committed cassette.
PMAK validation and PMAK-identity preflight probe. Called from the API-key validator and the credential preflight; not used to choose Bifrost team headers. No committed cassette.
